summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of Si-Scoring Kalteng. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass covering login (all 4 roles), invalid login, indicator/period seed, admin role gate, user CRUD, full submission workflow (create -> submit-before-upload rejection -> 11 uploads -> submit -> verifikator reject-without-note rejected -> reject-with-note -> perangkat sees rejection note -> re-upload -> resubmit -> approve -> penilai scores 11 vars -> total/category computed -> perangkat sees status=selesai), reject-without-note validation, perangkat cannot verify (403), upload lock blocks upload (403), stats endpoints for all roles. Frontend: login works for all 4 roles, invalid login shows error, admin sees Pengguna/Indikator/Periode tabs, perangkat can open the create-submission dialog, both Radix selects (14 areas / 36 urusan) work, create-submission renders detail modal with 11 upload inputs and StatusStepper. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS uses only FRONTEND_URL origin plus allow_credentials=True; that is correct for cookie auth but CORS_ORIGINS env var is unused - consider removing dead config to avoid confusion.

check_upload_allowed compares today > end_date lexicographically on YYYY-MM-DD strings; works but consider proper date parsing to also validate start_date (currently perangkat can upload before start_date).
submit-before-upload compares str(i['id']) against uploads keys - works because ids are already strings but the str() cast is unnecessary/misleading.
score_submission checks len(input.scores) == len(indicators) but does not verify indicator_id uniqueness - a penilai could submit 11 scores all for the same indicator and pass.
seed() is idempotent for admin password but new demo users are not re-synced if password changed later (only inserted if missing) - acceptable but worth documenting.
storage_key global is process-local; safe for single worker but if backend scales horizontally, races on 404 re-init could occur (currently fine).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login all roles, submission create + 11 upload slots render)

test_credentials: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (all four roles - verified login succeeds).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed submissions/users; user is cleaned up. Test submissions remain in DB but are clearly marked with TEST_ prefix on device_name.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend workflow already covered by /app/backend/tests/test_e2e_scoring.py - simply re-run with `pytest backend/tests/ -v`. Frontend Radix Select pattern: click trigger, wait 300ms, click [role='option']. All key data-testids are present. UI smoke covered create-submission dialog rendering 11 upload inputs; full multi-role browser E2E was not exhaustively re-run because backend covers it authoritatively.
